content.comment_body: Hello, I am interested in setting restrictions for each user, such that one user can modify only specific variable memory while another user can modify all variable memory. I checked the documentation and it seems this cannot be done, but please let me know if there is an alternative solution. Thanks.
As far as I know, this feature is not available. I have not found any relevant settings for it. You may consider submitting a support request.

Can multiple variable memory addresses be written to using a single SMS (specifically on the [product_name] basis module via the [product_name] communication module)? After reviewing both the manual and sample application [document], it appears only one SMS can be sent per VM address at a time. Please confirm if there is a way to batch this process. Thanks.

analysis.insight_summary: Users seek advanced access control and multi-variable update functionality for [product_name] platforms. Current [product_name] documentation lacks clarity on these options, resulting in confusion and unmet needs for flexible access management and bulk communication methods. This has led users to search manually and express frustration over missing features.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate having the ability to customize variable memory permissions per user and to send one SMS for updating several VM addresses in one action.
